svg.title: Measure PL on a quartz support
svg.desc: Measure silver superlattice photoluminescence on a quartz substrate using a Jobin Yvon FluoroMax-2 and the 250 nm line of a Xe lamp. Specimen deposition and loading are not described; no shared physical aliquot with TEM is asserted. Conceptual geometry; no measured apparatus design.

g.text: Measure PL on a quartz support
Source-bound concept; geometry is illustrative, not measured.
Qiu et al. 2006 · Supplied PDF pp. 2–3 · Exact locators in protocol
